market_summary: Monday Nov 2 US close: S&P 500 -0.5%, Nasdaq -1.1%, SOX -3.4% (about 22% below its Oct 6 high, a bear market) while the Dow rose 0.4% and oil fell nearly 8% on US-Iran talk hopes. The RBA hiked 25bp to 4.85% on Nov 3, a 6-3 vote, citing a materially higher inflation outlook. Tuesday Asia: KOSPI fell more than 3% early (Samsung, SK hynix about -5%), ASX +0.4%, Hang Seng slightly higher. Intraday Tuesday about 1:40pm ET: S&P 500 +0.7%, Nasdaq +1.1%, Dow -0.2% as chips rebound and Apple slips after earnings; 10-yr about 4.95%, WTI about $96 (-0.5%), Brent about $103. September JOLTS openings rose to 7.5M from a revised 7.2M; midterm options priced about a 0.9% S&P move today, results from about 11:00 AEDT Wed. Next, AEDT: midterm results from 11am Wed; Astera, AMD, Supermicro results Wed morning; US jobs 12:30am Sat.

AMZN.reason: Rose 2.2% Monday while the Nasdaq fell 1.1%, one of the few big tech names up as money left chips.

AXOS.reason: No new company news found since Monday.

BABA.reason: No new company news found. Apple reported Greater China revenue up 21%, a sign that China consumer demand is holding up.

ENPH.reason: No company news. Energy was one of only two sectors to fall sharply Monday, as oil dropped on hopes of US-Iran talks.

FIGR.reason: No new company news found since Monday.

GOOGL.reason: Still down about 12% from late last week after its Q3 report. No Monday move confirmed.

LDI.reason: No new company news found. Midterm results could shift the outlook for mortgage rates.

META.reason: No new company news found. Big tech capex is expected above 700B this year, per Euronews.

MRVL.reason: Fell 12.7% Monday on the all-stock Lumentum deal; Lumentum fell 18.6%. Chips rebounded early Tuesday. Deal closes 1H 2028.

MU.reason: Fell 5.8% Monday in the chip selloff. Apple said memory costs are the main squeeze on its margins, which shows memory makers have pricing power.

NFLX.reason: No new company news found since Monday.

NVDA.reason: Fell 1.3% Monday as chips sold off. Holds stakes in both Marvell and Lumentum. Chips led the rebound early Tuesday.

RKT.reason: No new company news found. Midterm results could shift the outlook for mortgage rates.

TSM.reason: No new company news found. Moved with the chip selloff Monday and the rebound Tuesday; its own moves were not checked.

headlines: RBA raised the cash rate 25bp to 4.85% on a 6-3 vote; inflation seen above band until late 2027.
Monday: chips fell 3.4%, now about 22% below the Oct 6 high; Marvell -12.7%, Lumentum -18.6%, Micron -5.8%.
Apple beat on revenue and iPhone (+17%) but guided margins lower on memory costs; down about 3% after hours.
Tuesday midday rebound: Nasdaq up 1.1%, S&P up 0.7%, on US midterm election day.
Bloom Energy up about 11% on a Barclays upgrade and a 1 GW fuel-cell deal.
Next, AEDT: midterm results from 11am Wed; Astera and AMD results Wed morning.
